svg.title: RNA
svg.desc: Single-stranded RNA with ribose-phosphate backbone, exposed bases, stem-loop hairpin, and 5-prime/3-prime direction. Biological basis: RNA is usually single-stranded but forms intramolecular base-paired stems and loops that support recognition and catalysis.
